High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Restricted Access (Decipher Errata 1998)|Restricted Access (PC Errata)]] (the card with its Players Committee errata text and the errata mark) (Cloud City, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Restricted Access _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1C8KCawP4Uc1f_uGhmOtRIvgKzRQPHmhp/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Restricted Access _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,232 bytes, SHA-256 <code>169302fe51f1a001c54db6781e2231884c02a67aa5231dd940647c40e55820cb</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:CC-D-restrictedaccess.gif]].

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
